lines.text: Nebuzaradan releases the chained Jeremiah at Ramah and tells him he may go with him to Babylon or go anywhere.
Nebuzaradan gives Jeremiah a ration and a letter, and Jeremiah goes to Gedaliah at Mizpah.
Commanders come to Gedaliah at Mizpah, and he swears an oath telling them to serve the king of Babylon.
Jews from Moab, Ammon, Edom, and other lands return to Judah and gather abundant wine grapes and summer fruit.
Johanan warns that Baalis king of the Egyptians sent Ishmael to kill Gedaliah, but Gedaliah does not believe him.
